sentences.text:
: 
Pallavi Mishra, Smriti Mishra, Vivek Prakash Mishra 
Counsel for Opposite Party(s) 
Soni Singh @ Kiran Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 October, 2025

: 
G.A. 
 In Chamber
 Hon'Ble Siddharth, J. 
1.

Despite service of notice on 30.08.2025 on the other side no one has put in appearance to oppose
this revision.

2. Heard Sri Vivek Prakash Mishra, counsel for the revisionist and learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material on record.
3.

This criminal revision has been filed against the impugned judgment and order dated 20.07.2023 passed by the Court of Juvenile Justice Board, Ballia, in Misc. Case No. 355 of 2014 (State Vs. X (minor)) and appellate order dated 10.10.2024 passed by Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Ballia, in Criminal Appeal No. 64 of 2024, arising out of F.I.R.No./Case Crime No. 160/2002, under sections- 376 IPC, Police Station- Rasra, District- Ballia,
4.

entities.text: Court of Juvenile Justice Board, Ballia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The opposite party no.2 was acquitted by the Juvenile Justice Board by the judgment and order dated 20.07.2023.

The revisionist preferred Appeal No.64 of 2024, against the aforesaid order before the Children's Court, which was dismissed by the Judgment and Order dated 10.10.2024,
hence this revision.
5. The appeal has been dismissed by the Appellate Court relying upon Section-52 (2) of the Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection of Children) Act, 2000.

entities.text: Juvenile Justice (Care & Protection of Children) Act, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 6. The Leaned Counsel for the Appellant has filed written submissions, but has not addressed the issue how appeal of the revisionist was maintainable before the Appellate Court.
He has relied upon Case Laws, which relates to the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Code.
7. The order of the appellate court seems justified.

9. Let the trial court record be returned to the trial court within a week.
(Siddharth,J.) October 6, 2025 Abhishek  Soni Singh @ Kiran Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 October, 2025
